title: Parallax Episode Visual Identity Card
description: Per-episode lock of cross-register visual decisions. Coordinates the AI-generated content (Registers 2/3 via tools/recraft/recraft.py) and Remotion analytical layer (Register 1 via theme.ts) so an episode's visual identity is decided once and propagates everywhere. Created by visual-spec skill from the angle memo's visual arc; consumed by visual-spec when emitting briefs, by theme.ts via assembly-manifest's episodeColorEmphasis, and by render-qa when validating cross-register continuity.

$schema.description: Optional schema reference for editor tooling.

episode.description: Episode slug, matching the directory name (e.g., 'silicon-trap').

createdDate.description: When the identity card was first created (typically during angle-memo or visual-spec stage).

rationale.description: One-paragraph explanation of why these specific visual decisions fit this episode's content. The cultural context, historical period, and editorial argument that justify the chosen emphasis. Read by visual-spec and render-qa to inform per-shot decisions.

episodeColorEmphasis.description: Which palette subset to foreground in Remotion templates. Mirrors the per-typography palette emphasis in AI-generated content. See remotion-templates/BRAND.md 'Per-Episode Color Emphasis' and theme.ts getEpisodeColorEmphasis().

defaultTextTreatment.description: Default typography tradition for AI-generated shots in this episode. Per-shot text_treatment in shot-list.json overrides this. See project/TYPOGRAPHY_TRADITIONS.md.

defaultRealism.description: Default realism dosage for AI-generated shots in this episode. Per-shot realism in shot-list.json overrides this. Animated clips should always force flat per the animation-flat rule. See project/PROMPT_PREAMBLES.md.

defaultTreatment.description: Default brand treatment LUT for the episode. Per-shot treatment in shot-list.json overrides. See project/EDITORIAL_PLAYBOOK.md VIS-10 for register × treatment pairing rules.

visualMotif.description: Recurring visual element tied to the episode's named conceptual product. Per VIS-07. Introduced early (first 2 minutes) and returns at least twice, evolving across the episode.

name.description: Short name for the motif (e.g., 'closing trap', 'splitting corridor', 'lithography net').

description.description: What the motif represents and how it evolves. 1-2 sentences.

evolutionStates.description: 3-4 evolution states across the episode (e.g., 'simple net diagram in Beat 1', 'partially closed in Beat 3', 'fully closed in Beat 5').

assetReference.description: Path or filename of the canonical reference asset for this motif (e.g., 'tools/ai-video/style-references/style-ref_atmospheric_trap-encirclement_v1.png').

brandMarkPlacement.description: Per-episode brand mark (∴) placement notes. Defaults to BRAND.md spec; this section captures any episode-specific variation.

watermarkVariant.description: Brand mark color treatment for this episode (default amber for dark mode, oxblood for light mode).

thumbnailIntegration.description: How the brand mark integrates into the episode's thumbnail (e.g., 'after title as period', 'standalone lower-right accent').

compositionalEmphasis.description: Episode-type variant per BRAND.md → Episode-Type Variants. meridian = standard (Cartograph DNA), antipode = comparison-heavy (Dialectic split), stratum = deep historical (Tectonic strata).

transitionSignature.description: Cross-register transition preferences for this episode. Defaults to BRAND.md → 'Cross-Register Transition Signatures'; capture any episode-specific overrides here.

analyticalToGroundingDefault.description: Default transition when crossing from Remotion (Register 1) to AI-GEN (Register 3) or atmospheric (Register 2).

groundingToAnalyticalDefault.description: Default transition when crossing from AI-GEN/atmospheric back to Remotion.
